priorityList: Apply poisons, enter Stealth, and use Slice and Dice before engaging.
Use Deathmark when Kingsbane is nearly ready (under 2s), Envenom is active, and both Garrote and Rupture are ticking.
Use Kingsbane if Envenom is active and either Deathmark is ticking or its cooldown is longer than 52 seconds.
Use Vanish to refresh Garrote if the current Garrote was not applied from Stealth/Vanish and Deathmark is active or on a long cooldown.
Maintain Rupture with 5 or more Combo Points (or at maximum Combo Points if Darkest Night is active).
Maintain Garrote at all times, especially when it can be refreshed with an empowered version from Stealth/Vanish.
During Darkest Night, use Shiv as a generator if you are exactly 1 Combo Point away from maximum.
Spend Combo Points on Envenom if Implacable Tracker has fewer than 4 stacks.
Spend Combo Points on Envenom when at 5+ Combo Points (or at maximum Combo Points during Darkest Night).
Use Thistle Tea if Energy falls below 50%.
Use Ambush as your primary builder when Blindside procs or while stealthed.
Use Mutilate to generate Combo Points as your default builder.
Use offensive trinkets and racial combat bonuses (like Blood Fury or Berserking) while Deathmark is active.
